title: An Offer With One Answer
setup: Black's king has no air, and the rook on b8 is the only piece covering the eighth rank.
hint: Nothing of yours can attack the rook on b8. Offer it something it has to take, on the square your own rook needs.
explanation:
## The Idea

The rook on b8 cannot be attacked, so it has to be sent away. {{Qc8+}} offers the queen on the one square the rook watches, and {{Rxc8}} is Black's only legal move: the pawns box the king in, and nothing can block. Now the rook stands on c8, in front of yours, and {{Rxc8#}} ends it. The queen had to go first, because it was the piece blocking your rook's file.
